tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Uniqueness of Smooth Quotients] ↗ thm:linear-ode-existence-uniqueness 1. chA:A.19

Suppose $M$, $N_1$, and $N_2$ are smooth manifolds, and $\pi _1 : M \to N_1$ and $\pi _2 : M \to N_2$ are surjective smooth submersions that are constant on each other's fibers. Then there exists a unique diffeomorphism $F : N_1 \to N_2$ such that $F \circ \pi _1 = \pi _2$.
